gamma_deformation.algebraic_generation: All 22 retained one-body atoms are generated by derivatives of these eight Gamma factors through order four.

dimension_obstruction.conclusion: Any ordinary first-order deformation with fewer than eight independent parameters cannot generate the full 22-atom module.

fixed_qrow_operator_obstruction.logic: If a full-rank parameterized Q-row identity with the protected fixed recurrence operator existed, differentiating in every tangent direction would force L_BZ[Y]=0. Since H_k lies in that tangent span and L_BZ[Y_Hk](0) is nonzero, no such full-rank deformation exists.

scope: This rejects automatic parameter differentiation of a parameterized kernel certificate with the protected fixed recurrence operator as a generator of the full 22-atom module. It does not exclude parameter-dependent recurrence coefficients or deformation factors followed by new correction certificates; those are new certificate problems, not automatic consequences of the admitted Q-row identity.
